notices.short_title: 85625P0004-RFP Appraisal of Real Estate
notices.description: The City of New York Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS) is seeking up to five (5) qualified vendors (hereafter, the Vendor(s) and Contractor(s)) to perform appraisal reports of real estate in New York City, through the issuance of Work Orders. Appraiser may occasionally be required to perform appraisals outside of New York City as needed by DCAS. This solicitation is being made pursuant to the Competitive Sealed Proposal Method, Section 3-03 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules. DCAS Office of Citywide Procurement, Agency 856 will hold a virtual Pre-Proposal Conference. Please see the Address Location box in PASSPort for the link. If you are experiencing any difficulties responding to this RFx, please reach out to MOCS service desk at the following link: http://nyc.gov/mocshelp

notices.short_title: Board of Correction Public Meeting
notices.description:
The New York City Board of Correction will hold a public meeting on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 1:00pm. The meeting with be held in the auditorium located on the 2nd floor of 125 Worth Street. The Board will discuss issues impacting the New York City jail system.

More information is available on the Board's website at https://www.nyc.gov/site/boc/meetings/2026-meetings.page

                                                  

  • Wheelchair Access. The venue has an accessible entrance on Lafayette Street and elevators. There are accessible bathrooms on the first floor of the building.
  • Assistive Listening Systems (ALS). ALS is not currently in place at the 125 Worth Street Second Floor Auditorium.
